acceptance: A pre-commit hook or make check fails if pyproject.toml dependencies are modified without matching updates to docs/development/dependency-audit-raw.md
context: Slice 2 implemented in the same branch as comment-policy-pinned-notice-drift-guard: feat/policy-and-dependency-drift-guards, commit 9a25578a3d7727d8c6394bd3fbe8501f1664502a, PR https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox/pull/2829 to develop (OPEN, MERGEABLE). Guard: parse_deps.py --check already existed and make audit-raw-check already used it and ran in ci-lint; this slice adds the missing pre-commit hook (id audit-raw) in .pre-commit-config.yaml covering pyproject.toml, the generator, and the doc. Verified: parse_deps.py --check exits 0 on clean tree; manifest-sensitivity probe confirms drift exits 1. Finish after squash-merge.
description: Modifying dependencies in pyproject.toml requires regenerating docs/development/dependency-audit-raw.md via _project/scripts/dependency_audit/parse_deps.py. Today, this is enforced only by make audit-raw-check in CI. Add a pre-commit check or tooling guard that detects when pyproject.toml dependencies change without updating dependency-audit-raw.md, preventing push-time CI failures.
